interpretation: Latency summaries are medians/ranges of per-run p95 values, never pooled percentiles or confidence intervals.
Full-window SQL/CPU per verified cycle includes browser initialization, warmup, final reads, background work and observers.
The closed workload records latency only for operations completing inside the measured window; crossing-boundary cycles remain correctness-checked. Short windows are more sensitive to this censoring.
Closed workload throughput is not an equal-offered-rate headroom comparison.
A comparison alone does not establish supported capacity; assess the complete correctness, volume and recovery evidence.

limitations: Shared normal-service VPS with three repetitions per arm/level; ranges are observed variation, not confidence intervals.
Full-window CPU and SQL per verified cycle include setup, warmup, final reads, background work and observers.
Closed-loop throughput changes with response time; the equal-offered-rate comparison is reported separately.
Sparse backend/lock samples do not measure Ecto connection leases or prove no brief waits occurred.
The local generalized volume/recovery evidence is separate from this frozen 12-record browser fixture.
These results validate the specified workload and quotas; they do not establish a maximum supported user count.
